# فحم النخلة | Palm Charcoal

> Premium Saudi date-palm and coconut-shell charcoal manufacturer and exporter based in Jeddah — natural hookah charcoal, quick-light incense charcoal, and luxury BBQ charcoal for wholesale and global export.

Palm Charcoal (فحم النخلة) is a Saudi company operating from the historic charcoal market in Jeddah Al-Balad since 1434H. We hold five registered trademarks and serve restaurants, distributors, and international importers across the GCC, Europe, and the US.
